Tum toh itni door ho. Ab mera mann karta hai, shaam ko mere paas ho, mera friend ho.
Main chai-coffee banaun, hum dono ghumne jayein.
Suno suno suno suno, long distance try kar lo, agar aapko lage haan bhai jam raha hai, safety hai, main safe feel kar rahi hoon, toh phir aage baat karte hai.

Hmm, theek hai baat toh tumhari.

Maine bola do koi mil jaye toh okay, nahi toh phir koi nahi mila toh phir ab uninstall karne ka fayda hai.
Recharge karke kitni baar karun ye?
Hamari na aunty hai ek. Suno unko na bathroom mein protein jaata hai, tumhare paas kaunsi dawai achhi hai, uska naam bata do, likhwa do.
Kya karna hai? Kya karna hai?
Unko bathroom mein protein jaata hai, bhag jaati hai.
Protein jaati hai ki bleeding hoti hai?
Haan, sugar purani hai unki, toh protein jaane lag raha hai ab 15-20 din se, har waqt kehti hai kamzori hai, kamzori hai.
Toh woh doctor ko dikhao ek baar.
Doctor ko bhi dikhaya hai, usne halke se capsule likh diye the, phir kehne lage woh tumhara vajan zyada hai, woh pressure padta hai kidney pe, isliye woh leak ho raha.
Kya bathroom mein bleeding ho raha hai?
Bleeding nahi ho raha, protein ja raha hai.
Protein kaise jayega? Usse toh thakaan mehsoos hogi, woh hoga, protein kaise jayega woh?
Nahi, phir tumhe maloom nahi hai dawaiyon ka, tum naye ho gaye na, ya tumhare paas ye dawaiyan chalti nahi hongi.
Hmm, ye bol sakte ho, okay.
Okay madam, nice to meet you, enjoy.
Haan, okay, theek hai, okay, bye.
